short: Overt-trained ECoG decoding of covert speech (M04) and spectral outputs (M08) are standard; the overt-recording covert reference (M11) is ahead, but warped rest gets r 0.30 vs covert 0.34.
position: The paper [@martin2014] moves overt-to-silent transfer, established with EMG and ultrasound [@janke2010; @wand2011; @florescu2010silent], to ECoG and covert reading (M04, standard), outputs spectrogram and modulation features where the one earlier production decoder used two formants [@guenther2009] (M08, standard), and scores covert output against the participant's own DTW-aligned overt recording (M11, ahead; no earlier neural study in the Appendix population does this, and Kim et al. reuse it [@kim2025reconstructing]). The equally warped resting baseline reaches r = 0.30 against covert r = 0.34, so the covert effect is mostly alignment, and covert identification was individually above chance in one of seven subjects. A covert-trained comparison arm came only later [@komeiji2024].
